video_title: Bam's Top 4 Big Men List Is DELUSIONAL

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye calls Bam Adebayo's top 4 big men list delusional
quotes.quote: Whatever he's sipping on, I'm about to get a cup of that because he's drunk. He is drunk. He is drunk. I think Bam is a very solid NBA center. He's not a top five center in NBA.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins and Channing Frye debate Wembanyama's ranking and current player performance

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Put in Wembanyama second in anything is asinine.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: How would you rank these four players?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Wemby, Jokic, Bam, Embiid.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: If we're going to go by what they've accomplished?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: No, we're going by now. Right now. Today. Not today. Today.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Then here's the true list: Wemby, KAT, Jokic, Embiid.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: KAT's not on the list.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: KAT wasn't an option.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Well, he should have been on there. He should have been on there. I'm putting him on there.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Any list that doesn't have Wemby number one is not a real list.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye criticizes Bam Adebayo's scoring compared to Joel Embiid
quotes.quote: Bam is a very solid. We were questioning before the 83 points. We were telling Bam to shoot the ball. He was barely averaging 20 points. Bam has weeks where he averages 14 points. We would never say that about any of those dudes. Joel Embiid's leg is like a Twizzler in the sun during the summertime. That thing got no muscle, is loose, and he's averaging 30 points in the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye and Kendrick Perkins debate Joel Embiid's value versus Bam Adebayo's

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Give me one leg of Joel Embiid over Bam.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I can't say that. If you replace Embiid with Bam on that 76ers team, they're a much better ball club.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: If you put Joel Embiid on the Miami Heat, they ain't going to be nine or ten.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Yes, they would.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: No, no, because he'd be in shape. Joel would be in shape and he'd get his body right.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Bam is always in shape and on top of that, yeah, you talk about his offensive impact, but talk about Bam's defensive impact.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: It's great. His offense is very mid.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Joel Embiid's defense is very mid. He just can't move.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins chooses Chet Holmgren over Bam Adebayo for defensive impact

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Would you rather have Bam or Chet?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Chet.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Wow.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Chet finished, I believe, two in Defensive Player of the Year. If I'm not mistaken.
